blueprints.license_notes: Watermarked PREVIEW of a paid the-blueprints.com vector drawing (the vector itself was NOT bought). The preview is freely viewable on the product page. Reference only; watermark crosses the drawing; dimensions printed on it are the vendor's.
blueprints.depicts: Preview titled 'Porsche 911 Carrera 2 997 (2009)' (same image for MY2004-09); front view shows round auxiliary lamps in the apron corners (997.1 style).
blueprints.accuracy_notes: Manual reading: hubs ~210/~605 px, extremes 42-800 px -> 0.521 vs printed 2350/4460 = 0.527 (~-1.5%; Wikipedia 997 range 2350-2360 / 4430-4496 mm gives 0.523-0.533 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porsche_911_(997)).
blueprints.ratio_check_vs_official: measured WB/L 0.521 vs official 2350/4427 mm = 0.531 -> -1.8% : close (1-2%)

measurement_method: measured_wb_over_len = wheelbase / overall length measured in pixels on the side view (hub centres, bumper extremes); wheels auto-detected with OpenCV HoughCircles and checked on an overlay, or read manually from a 10-px gridded zoom. Typical uncertainty +/-1% (large drawings) to +/-2% (small/low-res). Compare with the sourced dimensions in ../../geometry.json.

porsche_documents_checked_without_orthog.note: No Porsche dimension drawings (side/front/top with measurements) were found for 996.2, 997.1 or 997.2 in any freely reachable official document; catalogue tech-data pages are tables only. Only low-res straight-on brochure photos of the 997.2 were saved (14-997-2-2009/brochure_*). 996.2/997.1 official 3/4 press photos are on netcarshow (URLs in sources) but are not orthographic.
